consequence.statement: Before upgrading from Strimzi 0.38 or older, operators running Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 must enable the StableConnectIdentities feature gate and use StrimziPodSets. The evidence does not say what fails if this step is skipped.
consequence.remediation: On the current operator version, enable the StableConnectIdentities feature gate and make sure StrimziPodSets are used for Connect and MirrorMaker 2. Then upgrade.

assertion.statement: If you use Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 and are upgrading from Strimzi 0.38 or older, enable the StableConnectIdentities feature gate and switch to StrimziPodSets before upgrading to 0.46.0.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for migration migration-required
